lines.text: Obed-edom had eight sons, because God had blessed him.
They cast lots for each gate, young and old alike, and the South Gate fell to Obed-edom.
The lot for the East Gate fell to Shelemiah, and his son Zechariah, a mighty warrior, received the North Gate.
Shebuel, a descendant of Gershom son of Aaron, was the officer in charge of the treasuries.
In the fortieth year of David's reign, the records were searched and capable Hebronites were found at Jazer in Gilead.
